enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan on for air circulation during the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chest. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Stretch legs. Turn onto back. Place arm over forehead. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on clothes. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Pick up kettle. Fill with water. Place on base. Press switch. Open cupboard. Take out plate and mug. Open bread bag. Take out two slices. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag and stir. Remove toast from toaster. Place toast on plate. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table and eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed for work and packing bag, phone and water bottle for the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Put on clothes. Open bag. Pick up phone. Place phone in bag. Pick up water bottle. Place water bottle in bag. Close bag. Pick up bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office during the morning peak
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Insert card into reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to office. Open office door. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails and meeting partner organisations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email program. Read emails. Type replies. Pick up phone. Make phone call. Hang up. Walk to meeting room. Sit in meeting. Take notes. Speak in meeting. Return to desk. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Print document. File document. Answer phone. Take message.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at a nearby cafe and cooling down away from the heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Stand in line. Order food. Pay. Take receipt. Find table. Sit down. Wait for food. Food arrives. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Walk out of cafe. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: planning upcoming community events, updating schedules and following up with volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open calendar. Plan event. Call venue. Send emails. Update schedule. Call volunteer. Take notes. Print flyer. Distribute flyer. Meet with colleague. Discuss event. Return to desk. Edit schedule. Send follow-up email. Call partner. Take break. Drink water. Return to desk. Continue working.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to home. Open front door. Walk inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light dinner with the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Pick up pot. Place on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil and vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Serve food on plate. Sit at table and eat. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting quietly with the fan on, reading and hydrating while avoiding air-conditioner use during the grid peak
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Drink water. Place book down. Lie down. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with the air conditioner on now that the peak period has ended
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Bedtime routine: washing up, brushing teeth and changing into sleepwear
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Take off clothes. Put on sleepwear. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan running for ventilation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Stretch legs. Turn onto back. Sleep.
